  "tokenized_directions": [
    {
      "step": 1,
      "text": "Crush {{ing_01|well washed barley, soaked the day before}}, place on the fire to be cooked."
    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "text": "When hot add {{ing_02|plenty oil}}, {{ing_03|a small bunch of dill}}, {{ing_04|dry onion}}, {{ing_05|satury}} and {{ing_06|colocasium}}, to be cooked together because this gives a better juice."
    },
    {
      "step": 3,
      "text": "Add {{ing_07|green coriander}} and {{ing_08|a little salt}}; bring it to a boiling point."
    },
    {
      "step": 4,
      "text": "When well heated take out the {{ing_03|bunch [dill]}} and transfer the {{ing_01|barley}} into another vessel to avoid burning on the bottom of the pot."
    },
    {
      "step": 5,
      "text": "Thin it out [with {{ing_09|water, broth, milk}}] and strain into a pot, covering the tips of the {{ing_06|colocasia}} [2]."
    },
    {
      "step": 6,
      "text": "Next crush {{ing_10|pepper}}, {{ing_11|lovage}}, {{ing_12|a little dry flea-bane}}, {{ing_13|cumin}} and {{ing_14|sylphium}}, stir well, add {{ing_15|vinegar}}, {{ing_16|reduced must}} and {{ing_17|broth}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 7,
      "text": "Put it back into the pot, the remaining {{ing_06|colocasia}} finish on a gentle fire."
    }
  ],
